title: Liber Sanguinum
subtitle: Aka The Bloody Book
text: The Liber Sanguinum is your guide to all things Hemomancy. Place a Bookshelf surrounded by Befouling Ash, then right-click the bookshelf while holding a Sanguine Formation. The ritual costs 100 blood. Right-click the book to read, or Shift-Right-click to open the skill tree.
